name: Athallian Messenger
description: The Athallian Messenger was a courier starship that crash-landed on the planet Tatooine with a cargo of gemstones at some point by 36 BBY. Many treasure hunters subsequently searched for the vessel without success. Sometime by 4 ABY, the Eirrauc traders Daushoroc and Tamoss also attempted to find the Messenger in order to use the profits from the search to liberate other members of their species from enslavement.
